answer: Price identities by shared payout address. Every key that binds the same verified SOL or ETH payout address posts a grading bond of 500 x n^2 POA, where n is its rank on that address, so ten keys on one wallet lock 192,500 POA instead of 5,000. Rebinding freezes payouts for 26 epochs, so the address is timber that cannot be swapped quietly. An honest garden of one key per wallet pays 500; a farm cannot whisper its way past the ledger.
